intro: If you want a new hotel in central Phitsanulok with clean, modern rooms at a wallet-friendly price, Holatel Phitsanulok is a name that comes up more and more in recent reviews · This midrange 3-star, 41-room hotel opened in 2020 on Mitrapap Road, Nai Mueang, a roughly 6-minute walk from Wat Phra Si Rattana Mahathat (Wat Yai) where you can pay respects to Phra Phuttha Chinnarat · What reviewers consistently praise is how new and clean the rooms feel, the comfortable bedding, friendly staff and free parking · Rooms from approx ฿650/night

body.html: Holatel Phitsanulok opened in 2020 on Mitrapap Road, Nai Mueang — a central location that puts Wat Yai within walking distance and sits in the city's restaurant and market district · It's a midrange 41-room hotel whose main draw is the newness of the building and the modern, clean room design at an accessible price · Guests coming to pay respects to Phra Phuttha Chinnarat, here for work, or stopping over in Phitsanulok before continuing to Sukhothai or Khao Kho tend to pick it for a new room that feels good value.

Rooms are decorated in a warm, modern style with air conditioning, a flat-screen TV, free Wi-Fi and bedding many guests describe as soft and comfortable · The thing reviewers say most often is that the rooms are new, clean, nicely designed and quiet · There are Deluxe rooms with a queen or twin beds, and smaller Business rooms for solo travellers · Worth knowing: some budget Business rooms are compact and a few have no window — if you want a bright room with natural light, go for a Deluxe with a window.
"A new hotel, the room was so clean, the design looked better than the price, soft bedding, and an easy morning walk to Wat Yai. The staff were lovely too."

Service is another strong point · Staff are praised for being friendly and helpful, the front desk runs 24 hours, there is luggage storage, and airport pick-up/drop-off is available for an extra charge · The hotel has free private parking, which is very convenient for self-drivers, plus a small garden, an in-house restaurant and a bar · Breakfast is American-style — most reviews say it's tasty and nicely presented, even if the spread isn't as large as a big hotel's — a solid way to start the day before heading out.

The location works well for exploring Phitsanulok city · It's about a 6-minute walk to Wat Phra Si Rattana Mahathat (Wat Yai), after which you can stroll along the Nan River · It sits on Mitrapap Road near city eateries and markets, with the train station and bus terminal just a few minutes' drive away · Central Plaza Phitsanulok is about a 10-minute drive · The overall score sits around 9.1 from 55 Trip.com reviews — high for a hotel at this level in the city.

To be honest, Holatel is a small city hotel with no river view and no swimming pool · With only 41 rooms and a still-modest review count, it fills up fast on long weekends and holidays, so book ahead · If you want a room overlooking the Nan River or a riverside boutique feel, Dragon River Avenue or Grand Riverside may suit better · But if you want a new, clean, modern-design room in the city centre, within walking distance of the temple, with free parking and an easy price — Holatel offers value that's hard to find in this area.

A tip from following reviews here: choose a Deluxe room with a window for a brighter space with natural light over the cheaper Business rooms · If you're driving, the free on-site parking is a real advantage in a city where parking is scarce · And during festivals or long weekends when many people come to pay respects to Phra Phuttha Chinnarat, book ahead, as rooms are limited and sell out quickly.

faq.q: Where is Holatel Phitsanulok · can you walk to Wat Yai?
faq.a: It's at 5 Mitrapap Road, Nai Mueang, in central Phitsanulok · It's about a 6-minute walk to Wat Phra Si Rattana Mahathat (Wat Yai) to pay respects to Phra Phuttha Chinnarat · It sits in the city's restaurant and market district · The railway station and bus terminal are a few minutes' drive away · Central Plaza Phitsanulok is about 10 minutes by car, and the airport about 15 minutes.

faq.q: How much does Holatel Phitsanulok cost · what room types are there?
faq.a: Rooms start from approx ฿650/night for a Business single · There are Deluxe rooms with a queen or twin beds that are larger and have a window from around ฿900–950 · Prices vary by date and platform, so compare a few sites before booking.

faq.q: Who is Holatel Phitsanulok best for?
faq.a: It's a great fit for anyone who wants a new, clean, modern-design hotel in the city centre, within walking distance of Wat Yai, with free parking at an easy price · The newness and cleanliness of the rooms are the standout · Ideal for self-drivers, business travellers, or those stopping in Phitsanulok before Sukhothai or Khao Kho who value a fresh, good-value room over a river view.

faq.q: Are the rooms at Holatel really new and clean?
faq.a: The hotel opened in 2020 and the newness and cleanliness of the rooms are what reviewers praise most · Rooms have a modern design and soft bedding · Worth knowing: some budget Business rooms are small and windowless — if you want a bright room with natural light, choose a Deluxe with a window.

Yes — there is free private parking, which is very convenient in a city where parking is scarce · Breakfast is American-style; most reviews say it's tasty and nicely presented, even if the spread isn't as large as a big hotel's · There's also an in-house restaurant and bar, a small garden, a 24-hour front desk and luggage storage.

faq.q: How many rooms does Holatel Phitsanulok have · should I book ahead?
faq.a: The hotel has only 41 rooms, which is small · On long weekends and festivals when many people come to pay respects to Phra Phuttha Chinnarat, rooms fill fast, so book ahead · The overall score is around 9.1 from 55 Trip.com reviews — high for a hotel at this level in the city — so choose a free-cancellation rate if your plans aren't firm.
